theatres.fullReview: From the songs of his mother’s heart to the whispers of a faithful God, David’s story begins in quiet devotion. When the giant Goliath rises to terrorize a nation, a young shepherd armed with only a sling, a few stones, and unshakable faith steps forward. Pursued by power and driven by purpose, his journey tests the limits of loyalty, love, and courage—culminating in a battle not just for a crown, but for the soul of a kingdom.
theatres.take: Reviews swing both ways, with the pacing the sticking point.
theatres.takeCounter: Viewers beg to differ — audience scores run well above the critics' line.
